net.coobird.thumbnailator.builders.ThumbnailParameterBuilder builder = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.builders.ThumbnailParameterBuilder();
builder.size(100, 100);
builder.format("png");
net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter param = builder.build();

String format = param.getOutputFormat();
assert "png".equals(format) : "Expected 'png', got " + format;

net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter defaultParam = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.builders.ThumbnailParameterBuilder().size(100, 100).build();
String defaultFormat = defaultParam.getOutputFormat();
assert net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter.ORIGINAL_FORMAT.equals(defaultFormat) : "Expected ORIGINAL_FORMAT";

System.out.println("__CHECK__ getOutputFormat " + format + "_" + (net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter.ORIGINAL_FORMAT.equals(defaultFormat) ? "ORIGINAL" : "OTHER"));
